prompts.prompt:
Asset type: transparent chess-game sprite atlas, 12 isolated chess pieces, portrait canvas. Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a strict 3-column by 4-row grid of equal rectangular cells. Exactly ONE full upright piece per cell, no overlaps. Row 1: WHITE KING, WHITE QUEEN, WHITE BISHOP. Row 2: WHITE KNIGHT, WHITE ROOK, WHITE PAWN. Row 3: BLACK KING, BLACK QUEEN, BLACK BISHOP. Row 4: BLACK KNIGHT, BLACK ROOK, BLACK PAWN.
Each piece centered horizontally in its cell, full silhouette visible with generous empty padding, bases aligned near the bottom of each cell. Front orthographic product view, very slight elevated view showing elliptical bases, consistent camera and soft upper-left studio lighting across all 12. Familiar recognizable Staunton silhouettes: king cross, queen five-point coronet, bishop slashed mitre, knight horse head facing left, rook crenellated castle, pawn round ball. Broad stable turned bases. Both armies same coherent design. Chess pieces, never human figures.
Genuinely transparent background and clear transparent gutters. No backdrop, chessboard, floor, framing, lettering, labels, grid lines, watermark, loose objects, floating sparkles, cast shadows, or contact shadows. No pieces clipped by canvas or cells. Preserve strong light/dark army distinction and bold readable silhouettes at 50px game size.
Art direction: KINTSUGI porcelain sculpture, heirloom Japanese ceramic chess. White army warm ivory crackled glazed porcelain with fine intentional seams of metallic gold repairing the surface; black army deep charcoal-black glazed porcelain with fine gold kintsugi seams. Rich pottery texture, restrained delicate gold leaf, subtly hand-carved scallops at bases and crowned heads. Beautiful tactile collectible product rendering, grounded and artistic like realistic Granite Staunton pieces, NOT cartoon. White bodies must remain clearly ivory, black bodies must remain clearly black; gold is only a thin accent.

Art direction: AURORA GLASS sculptural chess, hand-blown art glass with graceful twisting internal ribbons and subtle Art Nouveau fluting. White army luminous milky opal frosted glass with pale mint and ice-blue swirls; black army opaque deep midnight-indigo glass with amethyst and teal internal swirls. Jewel-like polished broad bases, controlled iridescent highlights. Bodies mostly opaque so pieces read clearly on a board, transparency only in tiny edge highlights. Beautiful tangible collectible product rendering, luxurious artistic material variation on Granite Staunton pieces, NOT cartoon. White remains almost white; black remains dark navy-violet.

Art direction: VERDIGRIS botanical bronze sculpture, elegant Art Nouveau Staunton chess with carved flowing leaf reliefs and organic fluted stems. White army creamy pale limestone with softly burnished champagne-bronze leaf inlays, remains predominantly pale ivory. Black army deep oxidized bronze with dark petrol-green verdigris patina and selective warm copper highlights, remains predominantly very dark green. Delicate fern and ginkgo motifs sculpted INTO the standard piece forms, no foliage sticking beyond silhouettes. Tactile aged material, museum-quality craftsmanship, painterly refined product rendering, artistically richer than Granite but equally readable.
